attacks.name: Rule the Region
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hydro Break
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Subspace Swell
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

abilities.name: Star Portal
abilities.text: During your turn, you may attach up to 3 Water Energy cards from your discard pile to your Water Pokémon in any way you like. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

attacks.name: Metal Coating
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Metal Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Metal Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Star Chronos
attacks.text: Take another turn after this one. (Skip Pokémon Checkup.) (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

name: Omanyte
flavorText: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

name: Omastar
flavorText: Once wrapped around its prey, it never lets go. It eats the prey by tearing at it with sharp fangs.

abilities.name: Restoring Beam
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Restored Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.name: Dangerous Tentacle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon-EX with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Oshawott
flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Onix
flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

attacks.name: Harden
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon would be damaged by an attack, prevent that attack's damage done to this Pokémon if that damage is 60 or less.

name: Oddish
flavorText: Its scientific name is "Oddium Wanderus." At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

name: Octillery
flavorText: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

attacks.name: Hug
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Abyssal Hand
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.
